chunks: Muhammad ibn Yaqub narrated (elevating it) from Nasim, the maidservant, and the maidservant of Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him), who said:

I entered upon the Master of the Age (peace be upon him) ten nights after his birth, and I sneezed in his presence. He said: 'May Allah have mercy on you.' I was pleased by that. He said: 'Shall I give you glad tidings regarding sneezing?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'It is protection from death for three days.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of sneezing according to the Imam of the Age?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Kitab al-Ghayba*, highlights the early signs of authority (burhan) of the Imam al-Mahdi even in infancy, as narrated by his servant Nasim. The specific promise of 'protection from death for three days' following a sneeze serves as a unique physiological and spiritual indicator of divine preservation, reinforcing the Shia belief in the Imam's special status and the tangible benefits of his presence for the faithful.
